title: GpuParticles3D only sees GpuParticlesAttractorVectorField3D texture if GpuParticles3D was created after
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in v4.4.1.stable.mono.official [49a5bc7b6]
- Other versions not tested

### System information

Godot v4.4.1.stable.mono - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - integrated Intel(R) Iris(R) Xe Graphics (Intel Corporation; 32.0.101.7040) - 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-1240P (16 threads)

### Issue description

When I create a GpuParticlesAttractorVectorField3D and set the texture data on a later frame than when a GpuParticles3D was added to the scene, the GpuParticles3D will not react to the texture data that was set. Instead, it will act as if no texture had been set on the GpuParticlesAttractorVectorField3D (equivalent to being pushed in the [1, 1, 1] direction). GpuParticles3D that are added to the scene after the GpuParticlesAttractorVectorField3D will react to the texture data as expected.

For example, this is how things seem to work currently:
- On frame 0, create GpuParticles3D particles1. Particles are not being pushed.
- On frame 200, create GpuParticlesAttractorVectorField3D and its texture so that it should push particles left (-1, 0, 0). Instead, particles1 is being pushed in the default direction (1, 1, 1)
- On frame 400, create GpuParticles3D particles2. particles2 is being pushed in direction (-1, 0, 0) as expected, while particles1 is still being pushed in direction (1, 1, 1)

### Steps to reproduce

I have attached an MRP, which demonstrates a single GpuParticlesAttractorVectorField3D pushing two GpuParticles3Ds in different directions, which should be impossible based on my understanding.

A GpuParticles3D exists already in the scene. On the second frame, a GpuParticlesAttractorVectorField3D is added to the scene which should push the particles to the left, but instead they are pushed in direction (1, 1, 1). On the third frame, the GpuParticles3D is duplicated. The duplicated GpuParticles3D is pushed to the left, as expected, but the original GpuParticles3D continues to be pushed in direction (1, 1, 1).

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

See notes above. I used C# as I do not know GDScript.
[MRP.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/24068388/MRP.zip)
